close_reason: All 9 child beads complete. The CallerCtx mega-PR landed atomically across the 8 server crates (foundation jmap-server + canonical jmap-mail-server + 6 propagation siblings) plus folded-in JMAP-r3pg.14 extract_account_id reshape. JmapBackend now has type CallerCtx: Clone + Send + Sync + 'static; every backend method takes caller: &Self::CallerCtx first; every handle_* signature takes caller: &B::CallerCtx as second positional arg; every register_*_handlers function takes Dispatcher<B::CallerCtx>. ~129 handler functions, ~80 extract_account_id call sites, 9 register_* macros, 14 backend trait impls all coordinated. Quality gates: cargo fmt clean, cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings clean, cargo test --workspace --all-features all passing, RUSTDOCFLAGS=-D warnings cargo doc --no-deps --workspace clean. Unblocks JMAP-g7wu.2.4.
description:
Currently the four extension *Backend traits (jmap-mail-server, jmap-contacts-server, jmap-sharing-server, and the ClosureHandler in jmap-server) do not forward CallerCtx through to the backend. Adding the parameter is a public-API breaking change.

Affected sites:
- crate-jmap-server/src/lib.rs:271 (ClosureHandler)
- crate-jmap-mail-server/README.md:255 (MailBackend)
- crate-jmap-contacts-server/README.md:201 (ContactsBackend)
- crate-jmap-sharing-server/README.md:183 (SharingBackend)

All four sites describe the change as 'deferred to a future version' but have no bead tracking. Filing this epic makes it visible.

Per the canonical-template propagation rule in workspace AGENTS.md, the four crates must change together (or one canonical leads and the others follow within the same release window).

This is a 0.2.0-class change but should be tracked as active work, not deferred.
title: EPIC: CallerCtx forwarding through *Backend traits (4 server crates)
